Initial release of auditclaw-grc: an AI-native GRC assistant for OpenClaw with broad compliance support.

- Supports 97+ actions across 13 frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, NIST CSF, PCI DSS, CIS Controls, CMMC, HITRUST, CCPA, FedRAMP, ISO 42001, SOX ITGC).
- Manages controls, evidence, risks, policies, vendors, incidents, assets, training, vulnerabilities, access reviews, and questionnaires.
- Generates compliance scores, reports, dashboards, and trust center pages; includes local security header, SSL, and GDPR scans.
- Integrates with AWS, Azure, GCP, and GitHub via companion skills; uses SQLite with strict security.
- Includes interactive flows, emoji-based summaries, slash commands, and scheduled cron alerts.
- No external data is published—user controls all exports and reports.
